Mastering CSS Colors
: From Hex Codes to Modern Color Systems Understanding the Basics: How CSS Colors Work The Classic Approaches Hexadecimal Values: The web's workhorse. These six-character codes (like #FF6347 for tomato) represent red, green, and blue intensities. Shorthand versions like #f00 for red work when each pair is identical. Hexadecimal is compact and precise—ideal for matching brand colors exactly. RGB and RGBA: The rgb(255, 99, 71) notation breaks colors into red, green, and blue values (0-255). RGBA adds an alpha channel for transparency: rgba(255, 99, 71, 0.5) creates a 50% transparent tomato color. This explicit approach is great when you need to manipulate colors programmatically.
